summary: Full backend (pytest, 24/24 tests) and frontend (Playwright end-to-end for student/company/admin) testing of PlacementHub. All required flows work: health & seed, JWT auth for register/login/me, student stats/jobs/apply/duplicate-prevention/applications timeline, company post/manage/close/delete jobs and update applicant status with timeline entry, cross-company 403, company stats, admin stats with 6-month trend/top_companies/status_distribution, admin users listing with counts, admin can see all jobs including closed, admin delete user, authorization (student cannot POST /api/jobs -> 403; unauthenticated /api/applications/me -> 401), landing/register/login pages, role-based dashboards, dark mode toggle, and logout dropdown -> /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 659 lines — approaching size threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth/jobs/applications/analytics) and a separate seed module.
CORS uses '*' with allow_credentials=True (from env default). Browsers ignore credentials with wildcard; production origins should be explicit list.
Cookie sets secure=True + samesite='none' hardcoded — fine for HTTPS preview but will break local http testing; consider deriving from env.

Admin `/app/jobs` (nav-all-jobs) page renders but no job cards were detected with `job-card-*` testids — the admin jobs view likely uses a different component; consider unifying JobCard usage or adding testids for consistency.
Applied filter `search` uses case-insensitive regex against title/description/location but not skills; students searching by skill (e.g., 'python') may miss relevant jobs.
Trend computation uses fixed 30-day steps which can double-count or skip months near boundaries; use dateutil.relativedelta(months=1) for correctness.
No input length caps on job title/description or profile bio — potential abuse vector.

Frontend nav testids follow pattern nav-<label-slug>: student=[browse-jobs, my-applications, my-profile], company=[my-jobs, post-a-job, applicants, company-profile], admin=[all-jobs, students, companies]. Logout requires opening `user-menu-btn` dropdown first then clicking `logout-btn`. Theme toggle testid is `sidebar-theme-toggle`.
